conversion_consistency.note: Its segment was cached before the interruption and reused by the resumed run, while the other two runs converted it fresh; identical SHA256SUMS show that fresh and cached conversion give the same K1 records.

ak3.description: AK-3 report and appendices, first conversion

ak3-repeat.description: AK-3 report and appendices, independent conversion

ak3-resumed.description: AK-3 report and appendices, interrupted and resumed

determinism.note: Each run starts from an empty work directory; no converted cache is shared.

native_faults: Long-lived conversion processes stopped with a native access violation in the page decoder. The runner now converts each document in its own process, propagates failures and reuses completed caches; the underlying native cause is not established.

resume.note: The process tree was killed during conversion and the same run was restarted.

throughput.note: Single laptop run on CPU. Seconds per page count converted segments only; scanned pages appear under text because they are converted after the OCRmyPDF pass. The total includes OCR, rotation retries, form pairing and export.
